name: @operator/types
description: Shared TypeScript types for operator-owned cross-component contracts: browser-bridge capture surface (ControlPlaneCapture, OperatorContextPacket, CaptureEnvelope), event-type catalog, the mesh/sidecar/gateway/console-ui envelope contracts (ObservationEvent, BrowserBridgeResearchEvent, HMAC headers), the browser-bridge WS protocol (Action/Command/ExtensionMessage), the work-OUT dispatch/callback contracts (DispatchRequestV1, CallbackClaimV1), the project_binding.v1 data shape (ProjectBindingV1), and the console-ui read-surface DTOs (GoalDTO, TaskDTO, DbHealthSummary, RunnerSnapshot).

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test/*.test.mjs
